authorization: explicit user ruling 2026-10-04: I2 APPROVE / FROZEN; I3 GO under strict execution of the frozen checklist (no new variables, no gate changes, no added context). The two extensions below are the ONLY changes authorized by that ruling; everything else in the base contract is untouched.

changes.summary: I3 final classification is THREE-STATE, not PASS/FAIL

spec.THEORY_ELIGIBLE: all four R4 clauses pass (naive direction; date-dedup direction; leave-max-cluster-out direction; >=5 distinct observation dates per side)
spec.SAMPLING_DEPENDENT: relation exists and is testable (R4(d) satisfied) but at least one cluster-robustness clause fails — tested and found sensitive to sampling structure
spec.DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY: qualification gate is unsatisfiable BY DESIGN (e.g. distinct-date insufficiency); the relation is NOT testable for theory upgrade in this corpus regardless of direction strength. Distinct from SAMPLING_DEPENDENT: evidence-coverage insufficiency vs tested-and-sensitive carry different scientific meaning and must never be merged.

changes.base_contract_impact: refines the two-way wording in R4 ('theory-layer eligible / sampling-dependent') without weakening any gate; DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY is exactly the preregistered R4(d) expectation for ND-vs-NO_PIT (4 distinct dates on the NO_PIT arm), frozen before any I3 numbers were computed.

changes.summary: I3 must explicitly report EFFECTIVE EVIDENCE SIZE alongside every relation

spec.rationale: I1 proved 128 cases are not 128 independent environment observations; anyone reading nA=86 vs nB=18 must simultaneously see 74 vs 4 observation dates. Raw case counts must never be readable as independent-evidence counts.

changes.base_contract_impact: adds mandatory reporting fields; touches no statistic, no gate, no context variable.

interpretation_locks_from_ruling: ND vs NO_PIT can at most conclude: 'stable descriptive difference exists in the frozen corpus, but NO_PIT observation-date diversity is insufficient to rule out date-environment concentration, so the relation is not eligible for theory upgrade' — this limitation was frozen BEFORE I3 numbers existed, leaving no room for gate relaxation after seeing results
ETF 4v8 and 8v9 are the two genuinely discriminative objects of I3 (both sides have adequate date diversity)
margin variables are leverage-participation temperature ONLY; they must never be narrated as 大盘趋势, 国家队态度, 主力加减仓, 行业资金流入, or market-wide risk-appetite proxy
broad_index_regime / sector_regime remain DEFERRED; do NOT attach index or sector data to make I3 'more complete' — that would turn a clean preregistered experiment back into exploratory analysis

after I3, do NOT immediately proceed to broad-index/sector contextual layering; first see whether the two ETF relations pass R4 — if they cannot survive Tier-1 cluster robustness there is no basis for more external variables
